title: Danse Macabre
summary: Werewolf without a game master: five players jointly shuffle one wolf into a hidden deck, then submit sealed night actions whose total reveals the victim. The public site offers a solo browser session with four ghosts and an invite-link group mode on Esmeralda testnet. The creator notes that solo ghosts share the host tab, so privacy matters between separate players; table existence, seats, timing and fees remain public. November 2 review covered the MIT repository, public explanation and linked proof/threat-model pages. The recording is a website walkthrough, not a completed game or an independent cryptographic audit. The November 2 Ootle testnet reset may require creator redeployment. Optional stakes can be forfeited by a seat that stalls the table; the creator documents a 48–96 minute closure window. No game, stake or transaction was started during this review. November 2 organizer notice: Esmeralda testnet was reset; entrants were asked to republish templates and update their submission versions where applicable. Earlier recordings document their capture dates.
